rules.title: File path taken directly from a superglobal
rules.description: A request value reaching a file operation is local file inclusion, and with include it is code execution - PHP will parse and run whatever it reads.
rules.remediation: Map the input to a fixed allowlist of filenames. Never build the path from input.

rules.title: Query built from a superglobal
rules.description: Request data interpolated into SQL with no binding.
rules.remediation: Use PDO prepared statements with bound parameters.

rules.title: Loose comparison used on a hash or token
rules.description: PHP's == performs type juggling: two hashes that both start '0e' followed by digits compare equal as scientific notation, which is a documented authentication bypass.
rules.remediation: Use hash_equals(), which is both strict and constant time.

rules.title: extract() on request data
rules.description: extract() creates local variables named by the request, so a caller can overwrite any variable in scope - including one already checked.
rules.remediation: Read the specific keys you expect.

rules.title: Uploaded file moved without validating its type
rules.description: An upload written into a web-served directory with an attacker-chosen extension becomes a script the server will execute.
rules.remediation: Validate the real content type, generate the stored filename yourself, and store outside the web root.

rules.title: send() with a runtime method name
rules.description: send() can call any method on the object, including private ones. A method name from the request lets the caller choose what runs.
rules.remediation: Map the input through an explicit allowlist of permitted method names.

rules.title: Mass assignment without strong parameters
rules.description: Passing params straight into a model lets a request set any attribute, including admin flags and foreign keys.

rules.title: constantize/const_get on request data
rules.description: Resolving a class name from input lets the caller instantiate arbitrary classes, which is the first half of most Ruby RCE chains.
rules.remediation: Look the name up in a fixed hash of permitted classes.

rules.title: render inline: with interpolation
rules.description: ERB interpolation inside a rendered string is template injection, which reaches Ruby objects and therefore code execution.
rules.remediation: Render a template file and pass the value as a local.
